Sorry, but I only train rogues.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Hey, citizen!  You look like a stout one.  We guards are spread a little thin out here, and I could use your help...
Dare you trade for these tomes and secrets, knowing the power they hold?

$n, my favorite supplier! How can I help you today?

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Made by the finest craftsmen in all of Teldrassil, carried by hand from Kalimdor to Azeroth as a sign of the growing alliance between the people of the Great Tree and the humans of this land. If there is anything you require, you have but to ask.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Since the fall of Dalaran and the destruction of Quel'Thalas, wares of this sort have been hard to come by. But Lucan Cordell and some of our other Tradesman have been doing a fine job of filling our orders with quality merchandise.

Shut inside this little house, I dream of joining the battles that rage outside the city walls. Still, duty compels me to share my knowledge with others who fight in my stead... for now.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Ishnu-alah, $gbrother:sister;. Have you any tidings from abroad? My heart yearns for news of Teldrassil.
I am honored to share my knowledge with you, $N. See that you use it well.
The battle is won. For the time being, the Scourge threat has been pushed back. Our resources can be channeled into aiding you, in thanks and preparation for the future.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Have you come seeking training in the ways of armed combat?
I'm sorry, I'm a bit busy right now making horseshoes for Verner Osgood in Lakeshire.

Hello, $C.  I hope you've come to bolster our ranks.  Beasts and thieves are spilling into our beloved Elwynn, and we barely have enough men to keep the roads safe!$B$BAnd if you haven't done so, read that notice about Hogger.  He's a beast in yonder woods that must be dealt with.

I can't believe the officials in Stormwind, sending the bulk of our army abroad... when our home front is under so much pressure!$B$BWith thieves coming from Westfall and gnolls encroaching from from the east and west, it's a wonder Stormwind itself isn't besieged.
Rough times, huh, $N? No matter where you turn someone needs help, and my wife and I are no exception.
I try to keep Sentinel Hill stocked, and that's not easy with all the action we see.
Where are you going?  Well if you're looking to get there quickly, then look no further!

Greetings, $c - I'm a Commendation Officer acting on behalf of Stormwind.  It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Alliance Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from Stormwind for your duty and service.

We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.

As a mage, you are one of a select group that can conjure a portal to transport you back to this very place.  I can teach you if you are ready.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!$B$BGrimand Elmore, at your service!
The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!
What do ye need directions to?
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: What do ye need directions to?

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Mark my words!  You won't find faster gryphons anywhere in the Eastern Kingdoms than the ones right here in Thelsamar!

Welcome to Thelsamar, your home away from home in Loch Modan!$B$BThelsamar is a nice place, but it's not all beer and salted meat for those who answer the call to duty!  If you're willing to face danger in the name of the Alliance, then read the poster outside the Thelsamar branch of the Explorers' League.
The best miner has a firm grip on $ghis:her; pick, a stout heart in $ghis:her; chest, and thick, black dust in $ghis:her; hair.
Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: I don't suppose you're here to talk about my lovely Kali. Fine, then. Potions it is. Anyone ever tell ye you've got a one-track mind?
Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: Listen carefully, $N, for I have much knowledge to impart.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Where is it ye would like to go $g lad : lass;? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Where would you like to fly to?

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Hello there $g mister : ma'am;... do you have a little time that you could help us out?  Please?

Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: I think my necklace fell in the lake.  My daddy got it for me, and he's gonna be mad now.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Stormwind is the pillar of the human race, maintained through strength of will and the edge of a sturdy blade.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: May the Light protect you this day.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: I can train you in First Aid techniques.
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Do not turn your back on the Light, $c, it may be the one thing that saves you some day.
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: Do not turn your back on the Light, $c, it may be the one thing that saves you some day.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Don't let the humans in the Bazaar fool ye $g lad : lass;, with the subway those gnomes built it's easier than ye might think to transport goods from Ironforge. If they try to tack on import fees just tell them yer gonna buy yer gear from me.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Yeah? Ye interrupted me, so ye better have a blasted good reason to do so.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: You're not bad, but let me show you a few tricks you might find handy.
A far better blacksmith than I am, that's for sure. Though I'll deny it if you tell anyone I said that. You should go speak with Therum Deepforge. If anyone can teach you more, it's him.

Ye have the look of a Blacksmith to ye. Soot under the nails, steel in yer bones. Aye, very much the blood of a Blacksmith in yer veins. Which means ye've come to me looking to learn a thing or two, well $g lad : lass; grab a hammer. Let's see what I can teach ye.
These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: I don't admit this lightly, but you are a far better smith than I am. If you want to learn more than my meager teachings then I suggest you seek out a Dwarf named Therum Deepforge in Stormwind. You will find him in the Dwarven District.

Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: Hey! You look like you get into some scraps. I collect trophies from monsters all over Azeroth. If you bring me something good, I'll make it worth your while!

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Welcome to SI:7 headquarters, $N.
I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: I came from Ironforge to help out with the rebuilding effort here. If I can teach enough of ye my skills then maybe I can leave it to ye and take myself back home.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: I've heard it said that Deneb Walker, holed up in Stromgarde, has a book that is sure to help improve your First Aid techniques.

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Don't mind Skuerto, $N. He doesn't mean to be rude, he's just terribly busy. While we wait for him to finish scouting, why don't we work on something more productive?

Welcome to the Great Forge $g lad : lass;. It may be cold outside but we keep it nice and hot down 'ere. Grab a hammer, strike that anvil and show me ye've got what it takes to be a Blacksmith of the Great Forge!
If you ask me, there's no greater profession than a miner.  And if you ask me, there's no greater miner than a dwarf!
Welcome to me shop. What can I do for ye'?
Greetings, $N. I am Myolor Sunderfury, keeper of the Great Forge.

Welcome to Booty Bay, partner.  I hope your stay in my town is enjoyable and uneventful - emphasis on the latter.  We've got plenty of drink if you're thirsty, and plenty of bouncers if you're antsy.$B$BNow then... what can this humble servant of the Steamwheedle Cartel do for you?  Better still - what can you do for me, eh?

Welcome, $n. I am Landro Longshot - manager of the Black Flame. Perhaps you've not heard of the Black Flame until now. That doesn't surprise me; we work to keep things that way. We prefer to avoid... factional entanglements.$B$BThe Black Flame specializes in providing the finest services and entertainment money can buy, whether they happen to be hard to find items, gladiatorial combat, or lucrative games of chance.$B$BAre you here seeking something specific?
Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: Impulse purchases are the most fun kind of purchases!
The darkness does not embrace you, $c.  Cease your prattle and remove yourself from my sight!  Be gone!

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: You look like the type I should watch my coin purse around. Something I can help you with?

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: You're no warlock and I've no time for you.  Begone!
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: You're no warlock and I've no time for you.  Begone!

Field_1_15_8_63829_000_lang: Well met, $c.  My advice to you is this: as you travel the world, be wary of magic for it will burn the untrained.
Field_1_15_8_63829_001_lang: Well met, $c.  My advice to you is this: as you travel the world, be wary of magic for it will burn the untrained.

Ahoy hoy! They call me Brightbeard and I hail from a faraway land to the east. I come seeking to educate those with the proper aptitude and sufficiently deep pockets to become truly multitalented individuals.

No, literally. I can teach you to utilize multiple different talent specializations. Want to give it a go? All you need is a sack of fifty gold pieces and to have reached at least level forty as an adventurer.
